newsitem.title: CROATIA: BASKETBALL-SMELT OLIMPIJA EASE TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-SMELT OLIMPIJA EASE TO VICTORY.

text.p: Slovenia's Smelt Olimpija eased to a 66-53 away victory to beat Croatia Split in a Group C EuroLeague basketball match on Thursday.
The Ljubljana side led 38-31 at halfime thanks largely to the phenomenal Marko Tusek who ended the night with 18 points and 13 rebounds.

A good blend of young talent and battle-scarred veterans, the visitors were able to cruise a little in the second half against a much less experienced Croatian side who were forced to shoot from the unlikeliest positions.
In a tough group, which includes last season's champions and runners-up -- Panathinaikos and Barcelona -- Olimpija have now won three of their first five matches.
